test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The ‘PM-DAKSH’ Portal and ‘PM-DAKSH’ Mobile App launched in August 2021, were developed by the Ministry of ______ in collaboration with National E-Governance Division.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Social Justice and Empowerment.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• On **August 7, 2021**, **Dr Virendra Kumar, Union Minister** for** Social Justice and Empowerment**, launched the **PM-Daksh Portal and PM-Daksh mobile application** to make the** skill development programs **available to the target people.
 
• The app has been developed by the** Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, **in collaboration with the **National e-Governance Division (NeGD).**
 
• The** Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgarhi (PM-DAKSH) **Yojana offers **skill development training programs** for qualified target groups in the areas of 
 
 
• Short Term Training Program;
 
• Up-Skilling/Re-Skilling;
 
• Entrepreneurship Development Programme, 
 
• Long-Term Training Programme.
 
 
 
• The **target group **consists of **Safai Karamcharis, Backward Classes, and Scheduled Castes.**
